let usage () =
  prerr_endline "usage: app <port>";
  exit 2

let () =
  match Sys.argv with
  | [| _; port |] -> (
      match int_of_string_opt port with
      | Some port when port > 0 && port < 65536 -> (
          try Kvhttp.Server.run ~port
          with Unix.Unix_error (err, fn, _) ->
            Printf.eprintf "app: %s: %s\n" fn (Unix.error_message err);
            exit 1)
      | _ -> usage ())
  | _ -> usage ()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build an optimized release binary at ./app.
# Only the OCaml standard distribution (unix, threads) is required; no opam packages.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
dune build --profile release ./bin/main.exe
cp -f _build/default/bin/main.exe ./app
chmod +x ./app

(** Minimal HTTP/1.x message parsing and serialisation over Unix sockets. *)

type request = {
  meth : string;
  target : string;
  version : string;  (** e.g. ["HTTP/1.1"] *)
  headers : (string * string) list;  (** names lower-cased, in arrival order *)
  body : string;
}

type response = {
  status : int;
  headers : (string * string) list;
  body : string;
}

val response : ?headers:(string * string) list -> ?body:string -> int -> response

val header : request -> string -> string option
(** [header req name] is the first value of header [name] (case-insensitive). *)

val wants_keep_alive : request -> bool

(** Buffered reader over a connected socket. *)
module Reader : sig
  type t

  val create : Unix.file_descr -> t
end

type read_error =
  [ `Eof  (** connection closed (or timed out) before a full request arrived *)
  | `Status of int  (** malformed or unacceptable request; reply with this status *) ]

val read_request :
  ?on_continue:(unit -> unit) -> max_body:int -> Reader.t -> (request, read_error) result
(** Read one request. Bodies larger than [max_body] yield [`Status 413] (after
    draining the body when that is cheap, so the client can read the reply).
    [on_continue] is called before reading the body of a request that sent
    [Expect: 100-continue]. *)

val write_response : Unix.file_descr -> close:bool -> response -> unit
(** Serialise [response], adding [Content-Length] (except for 204/304) and
    [Connection: close] when [close] holds. *)

val write_continue : Unix.file_descr -> unit

type route = Health | Key_list | Key of string | Invalid_key | Unknown

let kv_prefix = "/kv/"

let route_of_target = function
  | "/health" -> Health
  | "/kv" -> Key_list
  | target when String.starts_with ~prefix:kv_prefix target ->
      let p = String.length kv_prefix in
      let key = String.sub target p (String.length target - p) in
      if Store.is_valid_key key then Key key else Invalid_key
  | _ -> Unknown

let method_not_allowed allowed =
  Http.response 405 ~headers:[ ("Allow", String.concat ", " allowed) ]

let text body =
  Http.response 200 ~body ~headers:[ ("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8") ]

(* Keys are restricted to [A-Za-z0-9_-], so they never need JSON escaping. *)
let json_string_array items =
  let b = Buffer.create 256 in
  Buffer.add_char b '[';
  List.iteri
    (fun i s ->
      if i > 0 then Buffer.add_char b ',';
      Buffer.add_char b '"';
      Buffer.add_string b s;
      Buffer.add_char b '"')
    items;
  Buffer.add_char b ']';
  Buffer.contents b

let handle store (req : Http.request) =
  match (route_of_target req.target, req.meth) with
  | Health, "GET" -> text "ok"
  | Health, _ -> method_not_allowed [ "GET" ]
  | Key_list, "GET" ->
      Http.response 200
        ~body:(json_string_array (Store.keys store))
        ~headers:[ ("Content-Type", "application/json") ]
  | Key_list, _ -> method_not_allowed [ "GET" ]
  | Key key, "GET" -> (
      match Store.get store key with
      | Some value ->
          Http.response 200 ~body:value
            ~headers:[ ("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream") ]
      | None -> Http.response 404)
  | Key key, "PUT" -> (
      match Store.put store key req.body with
      | `Created -> Http.response 201
      | `Replaced -> Http.response 200)
  | Key key, "DELETE" ->
      if Store.delete store key then Http.response 204 else Http.response 404
  | Key _, _ -> method_not_allowed [ "GET"; "PUT"; "DELETE" ]
  | Invalid_key, _ -> Http.response 400
  | Unknown, _ -> Http.response 404

(** Maps requests on the kvhttp API to responses. *)

val handle : Store.t -> Http.request -> Http.response

(** Thread-per-connection HTTP server for the key-value API. *)

val run : port:int -> unit
(** Listen on 127.0.0.1:[port] and serve forever. *)

(** Thread-safe in-memory key-value store. *)

type t

val create : unit -> t

val is_valid_key : string -> bool
(** [is_valid_key k] holds iff [k] matches [[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}]. *)

val max_value_size : int
(** Largest accepted value, in bytes (1 MiB). *)

val put : t -> string -> string -> [ `Created | `Replaced ]
val get : t -> string -> string option
val delete : t -> string -> bool

val keys : t -> string list
(** All keys, sorted ascending by byte order. *)
